messages.subject: Advanced distance sampling book
parts:
Dear Distance-sampling list,

We've just been informed that the Advanced Distance Sampling book is now
available from the publishers, Oxford University Press. We're extremely
pleased with it, and hope that you will find the contents both interesting and
useful.

More information about the book, and about how to obtain a 20% discount is at
http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance.book/
which you can also get to from the usual Distance page
http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/

I'm sure I'm speaking for all the other editors and chapter authors in
thanking the lead editor, Steve Buckland, for all his hard work, persistence
and good humour -- without him the book would certainly never have happened.

- Len Thomas
